verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows an llms.txt index, markdown docs, an OpenAPI schema, a Postman collection and in-product agentic workflows, but nothing documents a first-party MCP server or endpoint that external agents can connect to. These adjacent AI-readiness features do not count toward this story.
